summary: Implement the scaffold phase of the App Builder loop: a deterministic `appbuilder scaffold <slug>` command that renders a build-type project skeleton from an approved plan into build/<slug>/. No LLM in the CLI — scaffolding is template copy plus simple variable substitution. This first slice ships the whole mechanism end-to-end with a single CLI template, persists build_type in requirements.json, and emits a validated scaffold-report.json.
goals: Replace the scaffold placeholder with a working `appbuilder scaffold <slug>` command that turns approved plan artifacts into a runnable project skeleton under build/<slug>/.
Keep scaffolding fully deterministic and LLM-free: copy a build-type template's file tree and substitute a small, documented set of {{variables}} from requirements.json.
Make the framework build-type-aware in the artifacts by persisting build_type in requirements.json (enum-validated at compile), so scaffold selects its template from the plan rather than a flag.
Prove the pipeline end-to-end with one real template (cli) and a machine-readable scaffold-report.json, leaving game/app/library templates for later slices.
Preserve existing guarantees: zero runtime dependencies, the human-approval gate before seed, and a green test suite that does not pick up generated template stubs.

features.name: build_type in requirements
features.description: Add an optional build_type field to requirements.schema.json, enum-constrained to [game, cli, app, library, other]. compile enforces the enum when present; the field stays optional so existing requirements.json files remain valid. This is the artifact-driven signal scaffold reads to pick a template.

features.name: scaffold-report contract
features.description: A new contracts/schemas/v1/scaffold-report.schema.json (schema_version, project, build_type, template, generated_at, output_dir, rendered_files) registered in doctor's REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES. scaffold writes build/<slug>/scaffold-report.json and validates it against this schema.

features.name: CLI build-type template
features.description: A templates/cli/ template: template.json manifest (valid against template.schema.json, listing required_files) plus a files/ tree (package.json, README.md, .gitignore, src/index.js, test/index.test.js) using {{slug}} and {{summary}} placeholders. The single template that proves the mechanism.

features.name: scaffold command
features.description: A new cli/lib/scaffold.js module dispatched from the router. `appbuilder scaffold <slug> [--force]` gates on compilePlan, requires build_type present with an available template, copies templates/<build_type>/files/ into build/<slug>/ with {{variable}} substitution, asserts all required_files were produced, and writes+validates scaffold-report.json. Refuses to overwrite an existing build/<slug>/ unless --force.

features.name: Test-runner scoping
features.description: Scope the suite (scripts.test and the canonical invocation) to tests/ so generated build/<slug>/test/*.test.js template stubs are never discovered and run as framework tests.

features.name: Operator docs
features.description: Update README.md and HOWTO.md to document the scaffold phase, the build_type field, build/<slug>/ output, and the loop position (plan -> scaffold -> build).

constraints: No LLM or idea-parsing logic in the CLI; scaffolding is deterministic copy + simple {{variable}} substitution only.
Zero new runtime dependencies; the framework stays dependency-free.
build_type stays an optional, enum-constrained field so existing requirements.json artifacts do not break.
Generated code lives in build/<slug>/ (tracked) and must not pollute the framework test suite.
Test-first for all code; the full suite and doctor stay green; the human-approval-before-seed gate is not bypassed.
Implement only the scaffold slice with one cli template; do not author game/app/library templates or add unrelated commands.
